column1: # Component "base": Everything a device running this setup needs: shell, sudo, network, firewall, pacman, logging.
# Tab-separated. Repo paths are relative to the layer's root (the repo root); see scripts/sync and
# docs/repo-layout.md. Kinds: link (live is a symlink into the repo), copy (repo holds a copy),
# keep (a copy the program rewrites, synced both ways with the user's say), build (C source compiled).
